**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retry index construction after a recoverable build failure**

If a source temporarily exceeds an index limit or becomes unreadable, the failed rebuild clears the snapshot and sets `_last_build_error`; this early return then prevents all subsequent freshness checks and rebuilds, even after the source is repaired. I reproduced this by exceeding the per-file line limit, searching once, restoring a valid two-line file, and searching again: the navigator permanently reports the old limit error. Retry a bounded rebuild on subsequent searches so a recoverable source problem does not disable navigation for the remainder of the repair session.
